title: Canonical evidence generation orchestration for W03 closeout

waves.title: Evidence Command Implementation
waves.goal: Add and test the deterministic command that emits fresh canonical evidence for all required flows.
waves.objective: Add and test the deterministic command that emits fresh canonical evidence for all required flows.
allowed_write_scope: tools/post_test_review.py only for minimal adapter if strictly required
tools/log_watch/*.py only for minimal hook support if strictly required
frozen_scope: auth, pricing, billing, and report schema semantics
acceptance_criteria: Command exists at `scripts/generate_canonical_evidence.py` and defaults to all required flows.
Command exercises owned dev/test producers or backend logging helpers through existing flow contracts, not raw fabricated watcher pass payloads.
Generated records include fresh timestamps and stable trace/request/correlation or report/provenance fields.
Targeted tests prove freshness-window pass and stale/missing evidence failure behavior.
No watcher strictness is relaxed.
deferred_work: Final closeout watcher run belongs to W02.

waves.title: Strict Closeout Verification
waves.goal: Run generation first, then collect strict Today/Week/Admin/Catalog evidence for reviewer and architect acceptance.
waves.objective: Run generation first, then collect strict Today/Week/Admin/Catalog evidence for reviewer and architect acceptance.
frozen_scope: source code unless W01 gate accepted but closeout reveals a local blocker requiring rework
acceptance_criteria: Generation command precedes all review commands.
Today/Week review is `clean` or `degraded-but-expected`, not `no-evidence-blocker`.
Admin and Catalog watchers find fresh success evidence or return a precise expected blocker.
Reviewer evidence includes sample timestamps and identifiers for each flow.
Architect can accept W03 closeout without relaxing canonical evidence rules.
deferred_work: No frontend visual proof required because no UI is touched.

packet_candidates.title: Canonical Evidence Command
packet_candidates.summary: Implement `scripts/generate_canonical_evidence.py` and targeted tests for deterministic Today, Week, Admin, and Catalog evidence generation.
write_scope: tools/post_test_review.py only for minimal adapter if strictly required
tools/log_watch/*.py only for minimal hook support if strictly required
acceptance_criteria: Command emits all four canonical flow evidences inside the current review window.
Command uses existing backend producer/logging contracts rather than direct fabricated watcher pass records.
Records include timestamps plus trace/request/correlation/report/provenance identifiers.
Targeted tests cover successful fresh generation and stale/missing failure behavior.
No strict watcher verdict rules are weakened.

verification_profile.backend: targeted pytest plus `docker exec astro-project-backend-1 python3 scripts/pipeline.py`
verification_profile.observability: packet_local generation logs; `degraded-but-expected` acceptable only with explicit reason codes

reviewer_gate: No fabricated direct JSONL pass payloads.
Command name and verifier usage are documented in packet evidence.
notes: Prefer invoking existing router/service producer paths with deterministic stubs/mocks where needed.
If live credentials are required, stop and report blocker instead of fabricating canonical evidence.

packet_candidates.title: Verify Evidence Command
packet_candidates.summary: Run targeted command tests, backend quick pipeline, and packet-local evidence inspection for W01.
acceptance_criteria: Generation command runs successfully.
Targeted tests pass.
Backend quick pipeline passes or unrelated failures are explicitly isolated.
Packet-local logs show fresh records and identifiers for all four flows.

verification_profile.backend: `python3 -m pytest tests/test_canonical_evidence_generation.py tests/test_post_test_review.py tests/test_log_watch_feed_admin.py tests/test_forecast_catalog_watch.py` and `docker exec astro-project-backend-1 python3 scripts/pipeline.py`
verification_profile.observability: packet_local; inspect generated JSONL records and report verdict clean/degraded-but-expected/unexpected/no-evidence

reviewer_gate: Evidence includes command output and sampled log records.
notes: Do not run full frontend E2E.

packet_candidates.title: Review Evidence Command
packet_candidates.summary: Review W01 implementation and verifier evidence for strict canonical evidence correctness.
acceptance_criteria: Implementation stays within allowed scope.
Generation path exercises owned producers.
Watcher/reviewer strictness remains intact.
Verifier evidence proves freshness and identifiers.
notes: Escalate only if command cannot be deterministic without live dependencies.

packet_candidates.title: Architect Gate W01
packet_candidates.summary: Accept or block W01 from reviewer and verifier evidence.
acceptance_criteria: Wave evidence satisfies business and architecture fit.

packet_candidates.title: Verify W03 Closeout Evidence
packet_candidates.summary: Run generation first, then Today/Week, read-only, Admin, and Catalog watcher commands and store evidence.
acceptance_criteria: Generation command is run before all watcher commands.
Post-test review no longer returns `FAIL_NO_EVIDENCE` immediately after generation.
Admin and Catalog watcher outputs include fresh success evidence or precise expected blockers.
Evidence includes timestamps and identifiers for each flow.

verification_profile.backend: not required unless W01 changed after gate

reviewer_gate: Evidence order is generation before review.
All commands and verdicts are captured.
notes: `degraded-but-expected` is acceptable only with explicit accepted reason codes or precise blocker context.

packet_candidates.title: Review W03 Closeout Evidence
packet_candidates.summary: Review closeout evidence for strict canonical Today/Week/Admin/Catalog acceptance.
acceptance_criteria: No missing or stale canonical evidence is treated as clean.
No rendered-only or replay-only evidence substitutes for canonical logs.
All watcher outputs are fresh and traceable.
Any degradation is expected and explicitly justified.
reviewer_gate: Closeout evidence is sufficient for architect decision.
notes: If evidence is absent or fragmented, return rework rather than acceptance.

packet_candidates.title: Architect Gate W02
packet_candidates.summary: Accept, rework, or block final closeout from reviewer and verifier evidence.
acceptance_criteria: Wave evidence satisfies business fit, architecture fit, and strict observability fit.
notes: Final wave gate for this feature.
